_doc: Generated by forma/scripts/world_build.py + build_world_chunks.py. World coords: x east, z south (+Z), y up, metres. Chunk (ix,iz) covers x in [ix*256,(ix+1)*256], z in [iz*256,(iz+1)*256]. Same chunk format as world.json (test terrain), plus per-chunk water.png.
name: main_world
chunkGlbLocalSpace: Vertices are in CHUNK-LOCAL x,z in [0,256] with absolute world y. Place the glb root at (ix*256, 0, iz*256). Spawn_N / POI_<id> empties and Structure_<id> meshes are chunk-local too. props.json instances are in WORLD coordinates.

heightmap.format: 16-bit grayscale PNG, 129x129 per chunk, vertex-aligned (texel i,j = vertex at local x=2i, z=2j); row = z, column = x; adjacent chunks share their edge row/column exactly.
heightmap.note: NOTE: different encoding from the test terrain (-10 / 110): this world spans about 20..259 m so minHeight=-20, heightRange=500 (about 7.6 mm per step).
heightmap.triangulation: each cell is split along the diagonal (i,j)-(i+1,j+1); render meshes use the same diagonal

surfaceMap.format: 8-bit grayscale PNG (surface id per texel), same 129x129 vertex-aligned grid. surfaceAt(x,z): texel = (round(localX/2), round(localZ/2)), nearest neighbour.
surfaceMap.splat: chunk_*.splat_a.png (RGBA = grass,dirt,mud,gravel) and splat_b.png (RGBA = sand,snow,ice,water): blurred one-hot weights, visual blending only.
surfaceMap.note: Surface_Water mesh = river/lake BED terrain; visible water is the separate 'Water' mesh. ice (6) = frozen lake surface (drivable, no water plane).

waterMap.format: chunk_*.water.png: 16-bit 129x129, same grid; 0 = no water, otherwise the WATER SURFACE height with the same decode as the heightmap. Rivers slope, so water level is per-texel, not a constant. Water depth at a point = waterSurface - terrainHeight where surface==water(7).
waterMap.waterPlane: The 'Water' mesh uses the same per-vertex levels (minus 3 cm).

farLod._doc: Whole-world coarse data for far LOD. 257x257 samples, 8 m spacing; sample (i,j) is at world x = 8 i, z = 8 j (i.e. every 4th global grid sample, lining up exactly with chunk edges: chunk edges at samples multiples of 32). Row = z, column = x.

heightmap.note: Encoding differs from the test terrain (-10/110): this world needs -20/500.

surfaceMap.sampling: nearest sample of the 2 m surface map (narrow trails/rivers may be missing at 8 m)

regionMap.format: 8-bit grayscale PNG 257x257, ids: 0 countryside, 1 forest, 2 desert, 3 mountains, 4 snow

glb.space: WORLD space (origin at world corner 0,0, x east, z south), Surface_* meshes + Water, vertex-coloured; 131k tris, 8 m grid, no skirts

spawns.name: Spawn_1
spawns.note: vehicle origin on ground; add suspension ride height. forward = (sin yaw, 0, cos yaw)

props.kitIds: each instance has `kit` (placeholder id mapping onto the vegetation kit: tree_pine, tree_broadleaf, tree_birch, tree_dead, bush, fern, grass_clump, log, stump, rock_s/m/l; plus tree_palm, cactus, crop_wheat, crop_corn, fence, prop/ruin ids with no kit equivalent) and `proto` (Kenney CC0 fallback glb in props/)
props.format: chunks_main/chunk_*.props.json: trees[], rocks[], objects[] (world-space x,y,z, yaw about +Y, uniform scale, proto id) + structureColliders[] (oriented boxes, world space)
